name: Pima County, AZ
findings: Pima County has 2,986 nonprofit organizations. 1,365 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,108 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pima County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few union organizations list membership
observations.text: 10 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 30 would.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through union groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.text: 14 youth organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 39 would.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Pima County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 78 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 163 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
